spec.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os,json
files=['store/jobs/j000092/out/7zfm-ascii.txt','store/jobs/j000092/out/7zfm-utf16.txt','store/jobs/j000092/out/pid.6628.dmp','store/jobs/j000130/out/contact-extract.txt','store/jobs/j000130/out/contact-test.txt','store/jobs/j000130/stdout.log','store/jobs/j000145/out/contact-extract.txt','store/jobs/j000145/out/contact-test-slt.txt','store/jobs/j000145/stdout.log'];out=[]
for path in files:
 hits=[];tail=b'';pos=0;seen=set()
 with open(path,'rb') as f:
  while True:
   x=f.read(8*1024*1024)
   if not x:break
   b=tail+x;base=pos-len(tail)
   for s in ['Salvatore','hugostrange581','contact.rar']:
    for enc in ['utf8','utf-16le']:
     needle=s.encode(enc).lower();low=b.lower();start=0
     while True:
      i=low.find(needle,start)
      if i<0:break
      start=i+len(needle);k=(s,enc,base+i)
      if k in seen:continue
      seen.add(k);hits.append({'needle':s,'encoding':enc,'offset':base+i,'context':b[max(0,i-400):i+len(needle)+500].decode(enc,errors='replace')})
   tail=b[-1200:];pos+=len(x)
 out.append({'path':path,'bytes':pos,'hits':hits})
json.dump(out,open(os.environ['OUT']+'/new-sweep-contexts.json','w'),indent=2)
print(json.dumps([{'path':x['path'],'hits':len(x['hits'])} for x in out]))
PY
